page.title: Soil & Nutrient Health
page.description: A quick questionnaire plus your soil meter readings. No lab test needed.
page.noFarmDescription: Select or create a farm to start a Soil & Nutrient Health Check.
page.submitError: The Soil & Nutrient Health Check couldn't be completed. Please try again.

questions.growthStage: What stage is your crop at?
questions.soilType: What does your soil look and feel like?
questions.lastFertilizerType: What fertilizer did you last use?
questions.irrigationSource: How do you water your field?
questions.irrigationAdequacy: How would you describe your watering?
questions.symptoms: Do you see any of these on the leaves?

weatherStep.title: We'll get the current weather for {farm} automatically.
weatherStep.description: Temperature, humidity and 7-day rainfall come from your farm's location, so there's no need to enter them.

meterStep.intro: Take these three readings with your soil meter before submitting. They help us check whether your soil is locking up nutrients. All three are required.
meterStep.light: Light intensity in lux (from your meter)

wizard.symptomsHint: The photos are only examples to compare with your plant, not a diagnosis. Tick everything you see.
wizard.noneOfThese: None of these — the plant looks normal

soilTypeHint.sandy_loam: Mostly sandy, holds a loose clump briefly
soilTypeHint.saline_affected: Whitish crust or patches on the surface

irrigationAdequacy.insufficient: Not enough — soil often dries out

symptoms.yellowing_older_leaves: Older leaves turning evenly pale yellow
symptoms.purple_reddish_tint: Purple or reddish tint on leaves or stems
symptoms.stunted_growth: Plant clearly smaller or shorter than expected
symptoms.poor_flowering_or_fruiting: Few or no flowers or fruit forming
symptoms.weak_stems: Thin, floppy or easily bent stems
symptoms.interveinal_chlorosis_older_leaves: Older leaves yellow between green veins
symptoms.interveinal_chlorosis_young_leaves: Newest leaves yellow between green veins
symptoms.leaf_curling_brittle: Leaves curling, cracking or brittle at the tips
symptoms.short_internodes_small_leaves: Small leaves bunched closely on the stem

results.notSupportedTitle: Not available yet for this crop
results.notSupportedDescription: Nutrient and soil condition analysis isn't available yet for this crop.
results.soilConditionTitle: Soil condition may be limiting nutrient uptake

nutrientOverview.title: Nutrient Overview
nutrientOverview.description: Each bar shows how confident the soil analysis is about that nutrient's risk level. It is not the amount of the nutrient in your soil.
nutrientOverview.tableCaption: Confidence of the soil analysis for each nutrient's risk level
nutrientOverview.empty: No nutrient results are available to chart for this analysis.

conditions.description: Your meter readings compared with the ideal range GreenGuard's soil module uses for this crop.
conditions.idealAtLeast: Ideal for this crop: <num>{low}</num> or more
conditions.invalidReading: This reading is outside the possible scale, so it isn't plotted.
